description: After you broadcast createPool (GET /v1/pools/open/{chain}/{tx}, or GET /v1/pools/status by seller and asset): state pending | created | reverted | no_pool, the pool address from the PoolCreated log, confirmed on the factory (poolOf) and listed in GET /v1/pools. pending carries retry_after_seconds. Send chain_id and ONE of tx_hash (the createPool transaction) or seller (the 0x address; asset optional): chain_id alone is refused before any call.

chain_id.description: the chain the pool is on (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 5042 Arc, 4663 Robinhood, 143 Monad, 36927 the devnet)

seller.description: instead of tx_hash: the seller address (0x…); the answer is no_pool when none stands behind it

tx_hash.description: the createPool transaction (then seller is not needed)

name: taifoon_pool_status
